cards.ex: Dealing with these constant delays has left me at the end of my tether.
cards.exUz: Bu doimiy kechikishlar bilan kurashish meni chokimga yetkazdi.
cards.term: at the end of my tether
cards.uzDef: Sabrim tugadi, chidashga kuchim qolmadi degani.

cards.ex: The constant noise from the construction site is really trying my nerves.
cards.exUz: Qurilish maydonchasidan doimiy shovqin haqiqatan ham asabimga tegmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Bir narsa asabni buzadi, sabrni tugatadi.

cards.ex: We need to finish this project quickly, but we should make haste slowly to avoid mistakes.
cards.exUz: Biz bu loyihani tezda tugatishimiz kerak, lekin xatolardan qochish uchun shoshilinch sekin ish qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Tezroq bo'lishga harakat qiling, lekin xatolarga yo'l qo'ymaslik uchun ehtiyotkorlik bilan.

cards.ex: Luckily, he has a long fuse, so he didn't react angrily to the criticism.
cards.exUz: Yaxshiyamki, uning sabri uzun, shuning uchun u tanqidga g'azab bilan javob bermadi.
cards.uzDef: Osonlikcha jahli chiqmaydigan odam.

cards.ex: He's been on a hair trigger lately; you have to be careful what you say.
cards.exUz: U oxirgi paytlarda juda tez jahli chiqadigan bo'lib qoldi; nima deyishingizga e'tiborli bo'lishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Juda tez g'azablanadigan yoki reaksiyaga kirishadigan.

cards.ex: I'm sorry, I can't talk now, I'm in a rush to get to my meeting.
cards.exUz: Kechirasiz, hozir gaplasha olmayman, men uchrashuvga shoshilinchda boryapman.
cards.uzDef: Tezroq qilishga harakat qilmoq, vaqt kam.

cards.ex: She's biding her time, waiting for the perfect opportunity to launch her business.
cards.exUz: U biznesini boshlash uchun eng zo'r imkoniyatni kutib, vaqtini kutmoqda.
cards.uzDef: To'g'ri vaqt kelguncha sabr bilan kutmoq.

cards.ex: I had to curb my impatience and let the process unfold naturally.
cards.exUz: Men sabrsizligimni tiyishim va jarayonning tabiiy ravishda ochilishiga yo'l qo'yishim kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Sabrsizlikni nazorat qilish, o'zingizni ushlab turish.

cards.ex: High frustration tolerance is essential for success in a demanding field.
cards.exUz: Talabchan sohada muvaffaqiyat qozonish uchun yuqori toqatsizlik darajasi muhimdir.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchiliklarga yoki to'siqlarga sabr bilan chidash qobiliyati.

cards.ex: Getting approval for the project was a slow train coming, but we finally got it.
cards.exUz: Loyiha uchun tasdiq olish sekin kelayotgan poyezd edi, lekin biz nihoyat uni oldik.
cards.uzDef: Kutish kerak bo'lgan, sekin harakat qiladigan narsa.

cards.ex: His constant complaining would try the patience of a saint.
cards.exUz: Uning doimiy shikoyatlari hatto avliyoning sabrini ham sinaydi.
cards.term: try the patience of a saint
cards.uzDef: Hatto juda sabrli odamni ham jahli chiqaradigan narsa.

cards.ex: Don't get your knickers in a twist, it's not that big of a deal.
cards.exUz: Asabiylashmang, bu unchalik katta muammo emas.
cards.term: get one's knickers in a twist
cards.uzDef: Keraksiz narsalardan xavotirlanmoq yoki g'azablanmoq.

cards.ex: He lost his head and started yelling at everyone.
cards.exUz: U boshini yo'qotdi va hammaga baqira boshladi.
cards.uzDef: G'azabdan nazoratni yo'qotmoq.

cards.ex: The decision was made in haste, and now we're regretting it.
cards.exUz: Qaror shoshilinchlik bilan qabul qilindi va endi biz afsusdamiz.
cards.uzDef: Tezlik bilan, e'tiborsizlik bilan.

cards.ex: Just sit tight and wait for further instructions.
cards.exUz: Faqat qimir etmay o'tiring va keyingi ko'rsatmalarni kuting.
cards.uzDef: Sabr bilan kutmoq, hech narsa qilmasdan.

cards.ex: In this situation, restraint is key; don't react impulsively.
cards.exUz: Bu vaziyatda o'zini tiyish muhim; impulsiv ravishda reaksiyaga kirmang.
cards.uzDef: O'zini ushlab turish, hissiyotlarni nazorat qilish muhimligi.

cards.ex: It's just a matter of time before they announce the merger.
cards.exUz: Ular qo'shilishni e'lon qilishlari faqat vaqt masalasi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir albatta sodir bo'lishi, faqat vaqt kerak.

cards.ex: Remember, act in haste, repent at leisure, so think carefully before you decide.
cards.exUz: Unutmang, shoshilsang, pushaymon yersan, shuning uchun qaror qabul qilishdan oldin yaxshilab o'ylab ko'ring.
cards.term: act in haste, repent at leisure
cards.uzDef: Shoshilinch qarorlar qabul qilsang, keyin pushaymon yersan.

cards.ex: With every passing day, my patience wears thinner.
cards.exUz: Har o'tgan kun bilan sabrim tugayapti.
cards.uzDef: Vaqt o'tishi bilan, asta-sekin.

cards.ex: We were on tenterhooks waiting for the exam results.
cards.exUz: Biz imtihon natijalarini xavotir bilan kutdik.
cards.uzDef: Nimanidir sabrsizlik bilan kutish, xavotirlanib.

cards.ex: You're really pushing it with these demands.
cards.exUz: Siz bu talablar bilan haqiqatan ham ortiqcha ketyapsiz.
cards.uzDef: Chegarani buzmoq, sabrni sinamoq.

cards.ex: You need to have the patience of Job to deal with this bureaucracy.
cards.exUz: Bu byurokratiya bilan kurashish uchun sizga Ayub payg'ambardek sabr kerak bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Juda katta sabrga ega bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: His arrogance really grinds my gears.
cards.exUz: Uning takabburligi haqiqatan ham asabimni buzadi.
cards.uzDef: Asabni buzadigan, g'azablantiradigan narsa.

cards.ex: Before you react, just take a deep breath and think about it.
cards.exUz: Reaksiya bildirishdan oldin, shunchaki chuqur nafas oling va bu haqda o'ylab ko'ring.
cards.uzDef: O'zingizni tinchlantirish uchun chuqur nafas olmoq.

cards.ex: The project is progressing at a snail's pace.
cards.exUz: Loyiha ilon izidan rivojlanmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Juda sekin, juda sekin sur'atda.

cards.ex: There's no time to lose; we need to act immediately.
cards.exUz: Yo'qotadigan vaqt yo'q; biz darhol harakat qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Tezroq harakat qilish kerak, vaqt kam.

cards.ex: We need to nip this problem in the bud before it gets worse.
cards.exUz: Bu muammo yomonlashishidan oldin, uning oldini olishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammo boshlanishida oldini olish.

cards.ex: She's been jumpy ever since the accident.
cards.exUz: Baxtsiz hodisadan beri u asabiy.
cards.uzDef: Asabiy, xavotirda, tinch emas.

cards.ex: It's tough, but we need to stay the course and finish what we started.
cards.exUz: Qiyin, lekin biz maqsadga sodiq qolishimiz va boshlagan ishni tugatishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchiliklarga qaramay maqsadga erishishga harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: Give him some time to cool off before you talk to him.
cards.exUz: U bilan gaplashishdan oldin unga sovishga vaqt bering.
cards.uzDef: G'azab yoki hayajonni yo'qotmoq.
